```cypher
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '42000-1'})-[:EXPLODES {is_current: true}]->(p:Part)
WITH collect(DISTINCT p.part_num) AS currentParts
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '42000-1'})-[:CONTAINS {version: 1}]->(x)
WITH currentParts, s, x
WHERE x.part_num IS NOT NULL OR x.fig_num IS NOT NULL OR x.set_num IS NOT NULL
WITH currentParts, s, x
CALL {
    WITH s, x
    MATCH (s)-[e:CONTAINS*1..10 (r, n | WHERE r.version = 1)]->(p:Part)
    WHERE startNode(head(rels(e))) = s AND (x = startNode(head(rels(e))) OR x = endNode(last(rels(e))))
    RETURN collect(DISTINCT p.part_num) AS v1Parts
}
WITH currentParts, collect(DISTINCT v1Parts) AS allV1PartsLists
UNWIND allV1PartsLists AS v1List
WITH currentParts, collect(DISTINCT v1List) AS uniqueV1Lists
UNWIND uniqueV1Lists AS v1Parts
WITH currentParts, apoc.coll.flatten(collect(v1Parts)) AS allV1Parts
UNWIND currentParts AS cp
WITH cp, allV1Parts
WHERE NOT cp IN allV1Parts
RETURN DISTINCT cp AS part_num
ORDER BY part_num
```
